limits: Source metadata, synthetic native RPC replies and local integrity checks are not real native writer or provider acceptance.
Config completion and marker creation are separate writes; crash recovery between them is not atomic.
Failed fresh marker creation leaves a failed adoption with default config. Retry at default completes it; a /fast choice before retry cannot be distinguished from unmarked legacy fast.
Canonical native versions cannot attribute formatting-only edits before disk snapshot capture to another writer.
Additional owned migration rules require a declared partial-marker recovery policy.
No host apply, credential handling, merge or readiness change performed by this lane.
